purpose: Deep public-domain information discovery using independent digital, scientific, geophysical and transportation clocks.

candidates.name: Historical issuer web-state change × disclosure arrival
candidates.core_hypothesis: Publicly visible issuer web-state transitions may contain operational/disclosure timing not present in filing metadata alone.
candidates.next_gate: capture timestamp semantics, crawl lag characterization, immutable issuer URL map, future-capture invariance

candidates.name: Open-source vulnerability disclosure shock × software issuer exposure
candidates.core_hypothesis: Newly public package vulnerabilities may create a technology-risk information state before broad repricing.
candidates.next_gate: advisory publication/updated timestamps, fixed package-to-issuer graph, withdrawn/revised advisory handling

candidates.name: Flight-network disruption × exposed airline/airport ecosystem
candidates.core_hypothesis: Observed aircraft/airport network disruptions may encode operational stress independently of market prices.
candidates.next_gate: license/commercial-use eligibility, historical completeness, nightly-batch timing, fixed airport/issuer exposure graph

candidates.name: Marine/weather extreme × shipping and industrial exposure
candidates.core_hypothesis: Public ocean/weather state changes may create supply-chain and physical-operating shocks.
candidates.next_gate: dataset-vintage stability, station/entity geography, update timing and revision semantics

candidates.name: Seismic sequence state × extractive/utility exposure
candidates.core_hypothesis: Not just single large earthquakes but deterministic aftershock/sequence transitions may alter operating-location states.
candidates.next_gate: sequence-definition freeze independent of returns, event update timestamps, fixed facility geography

candidates.name: Science-output burst × issuer technology exposure
candidates.core_hypothesis: Accelerating public research output around a fixed technology domain may capture innovation intensity.
candidates.next_gate: deposit/publication timing, affiliation mapping, duplicate/venue correction and pre-frozen domain taxonomy

candidates.name: Space-weather state transition × infrastructure sensitivity
candidates.core_hypothesis: Alert/warning transitions may contain external operational information for communication, power and navigation-sensitive firms.
candidates.next_gate: issue/correction/cancellation clock, fixed exposure taxonomy and revision-safe PIT

candidates.name: Web-corpus × security-disclosure collision state
candidates.core_hypothesis: The interaction between public web-state change and formal security disclosure may reveal distinct dissemination phases.
candidates.next_gate: separate source clocks, collision definition frozen ex ante, no same-source duplicate information
